# Gramlot examples 0.2.7

## Changes

- The remote Source example `c08` (`08_remote_source`) is removed. It taught a page
  method marked with `@source` and called with `remoteSource` from a controller; that
  mechanism is not yet part of the page-writing API and arrives together with the
  `remote` grammar attribute and `@endpoint`.
- The end-to-end page moves from `c09` (`09_end_to_end`) to `c08` (`08_end_to_end`) and
  no longer loads a remote branch; its other steps are unchanged. The controllers family
  is now `c01`–`c08`, and the gallery has 33 routes.
- The development servers `scripts/serve_pages.py` and `scripts/serve_pages.mjs` no
  longer answer the Source route.

## Requirements

Unchanged: Python 3.11 or later with `gramlot` 0.2.5 or later; Node.js 22 or later, or
Bun, with `@gramlot/gramlot` 0.2.5 or later.
